It is a simple file system that allows users to perform basic file operations such as navigating directories, creating files and directories, reading and writing to files, etc. Tool description: Change the current working directory to the specified folder.

folder.description: The folder of the directory to change to. You can only change one folder level at a time.

current_working_directory.description: The new current working directory path.
